notes: All definitions verified against the live olist_copilot database. Monetary metrics are GROSS: the dataset has no refund, return, or cost fields, so net revenue and profit cannot be computed reliably. Every metric states its filters and caveats explicitly.

metrics.name: Order count
metrics.definition: Number of orders placed, counting every row in orders regardless of status.
metrics.sql: SELECT count(*) AS order_count FROM orders
caveats: Includes 625 canceled and 609 unavailable orders; an order row is not a completed sale.
For completed sales use the delivered_orders metric instead.

metrics.name: Customer count
metrics.definition: Number of distinct real customers, computed as COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) on customers.
metrics.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS customer_count FROM customers
caveats: Never count customer_id: it identifies order-side records (99,441), not people (96,096).
A person who placed several orders is counted once.

metrics.name: Average order value (AOV)
metrics.definition: Average total paid per order: SUM(payment_value) divided by COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) over order_payments. Includes freight.
metrics.sql: SELECT round(sum(payment_value) / count(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS average_order_value FROM order_payments
metrics.filters: orders with at least one payment row
caveats: Exactly one order has no payment row and is excluded from this metric.
All 625 canceled and 609 unavailable orders DO have payment rows, so their payment values are included. For an AOV of completed orders only, join orders and filter order_status = 'delivered'.
Includes freight; it is not a merchandise-only average.
Gross of refunds: refunds are not observable in this dataset.
Merchandise-only variant: SUM(price) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) over order_items (excludes freight).

metrics.name: Gross item value
metrics.definition: Total merchandise value of all order items: SUM(price) over order_items. Excludes freight.
metrics.sql: SELECT sum(price) AS gross_item_value FROM order_items
metrics.filters: none — items of all orders included
caveats: This is NOT net revenue: the dataset has no refund or return fields.
Includes items belonging to canceled and unavailable orders. For a delivered-only variant, join orders and filter order_status = 'delivered'.
Each row is one unit; SUM(price) already accounts for quantity.

metrics.name: Freight value
metrics.definition: Total shipping value charged to customers: SUM(freight_value) over order_items.
metrics.sql: SELECT sum(freight_value) AS total_freight_value FROM order_items
caveats: Freight is allocated per item; summing an order's items gives the order's total shipping charge.
This is the price charged to the customer, not the carrier's actual cost.

metrics.name: Delivered orders
metrics.definition: Number of orders whose final status is 'delivered'.
metrics.sql: SELECT count(*) AS delivered_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
caveats: Status is a final snapshot; the dataset has no status history.
8 delivered orders have a NULL order_delivered_customer_date; status-based counting still includes them.

metrics.name: Cancellation rate
metrics.definition: Share of all orders whose final status is 'canceled', as a percentage: 100 * canceled orders / all orders.
metrics.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE order_status = 'canceled') / count(*), 2) AS cancellation_rate_pct FROM orders
caveats: 'unavailable' (609 orders) is a distinct outcome and is NOT counted as canceled. A broader 'not fulfilled' rate would need its own definition.
The rate is over all orders in the dataset, not per time period; add a purchase-timestamp filter for period-specific rates.

metrics.name: Average delivery time
metrics.definition: Average number of days from purchase to customer receipt for delivered orders: AVG(order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp), in days.
metrics.sql: SELECT round(avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400.0), 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
metrics.filters: order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
caveats: Includes seller processing time plus carrier transit; it is purchase-to-door, not transit-only.
Excludes orders without a customer-delivery timestamp, including 8 orders marked delivered.
Transit-only variant: order_delivered_customer_date - order_delivered_carrier_date.

metrics.name: Review score
metrics.definition: Mean review score over all review rows: AVG(review_score) on order_reviews, on a 1-5 scale.
metrics.sql: SELECT round(avg(review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score FROM order_reviews
caveats: Averaged per review, not per order: 547 orders have more than one review.
Selection bias: only customers who chose to review are represented.
review_id repeats across orders (1,603 rows); count review rows, not DISTINCT review_id.

unsupported_metrics.reason: The dataset has no refund, return, or chargeback fields. SUM(price) or SUM(payment_value) are gross values only. Any 'net revenue' answer must state this limitation instead of guessing.
No product cost, carrier cost, or fee fields exist. Profit and margin cannot be computed from this dataset.
